images.title: CLUB HOME
images.prompt: A polished MAIN MENU in a bright robot clubhouse overlooking Harbor Park. Left third: simple vertical navigation PLAY highlighted cyan, CLUB, GARAGE, ACADEMY, SETTINGS. Center: two rounded expressive white robots in cyan jerseys 07 and 11 on a modest circular platform, high quality charming toy-like materials. Right third: next match card 'HARBOR CUP' 'VS EMBER WORKS', huge inviting 'PLAY NEXT MATCH' button; a small season progress strip 'ROOKIE LEAGUE · MATCH 3/10'. Top shows modest earned credits and club badge. Bottom a trophy shelf with only two earned trophies and several empty spaces, subtle goal of improving club. Broad airy composition, sunny warm light, cyan orange navy ivory interface, organized professional game menu, not a cluttered shop.

images.title: MATCH: SWING ATTACK
images.prompt: Full 2v2 gameplay view of Harbor Park from fixed elevated camera, entire rectangular field, two opposite goals, exactly 4 rounded robots, cyan pair versus orange pair, exactly ONE white ball. Cyan robot 07 attached to highlighted yellow side rail anchor via taut cyan rope, swinging around it toward ball, curved cyan motion trail with modest dotted tangent RELEASE direction. Other three robots position for a pass or defense. Top central scoreboard cyan2 orange1 time01:38. Bottom left compact controller hints 'HOLD: TETHER' 'RELEASE: LAUNCH' bottom right kick reticle hint. The core tether clearly attaches robot to fixed anchor not ball. Polished playable screenshot, minimal HUD, bright seaside backdrop.

images.title: ACADEMY: TETHER BASICS
images.prompt: A clean three-step GAMEPLAY TUTORIAL concept sheet within one in-game academy screen. Title 'TETHER BASICS'. Three equal large panels of same small practice arena and same white robot cyan07: panel1 '1 AIM' robot standing and yellow fixed anchor outlined with cyan selection reticle; panel2 '2 HOLD' rope taut from robot to that anchor with curved path around fixed point; panel3 '3 RELEASE' rope detached, robot moving along tangent arrow toward ball target. Physics visual must show swing around anchor and tangential release, not a teleport. Large bottom practical button 'TRY IT' and three small mastery medals. Navy ivory cyan interface and warm yellow anchors. Only simple short labels; the precise tutorial mechanics belong in separate documents. Original polished 3D visual style.

images.title: MATCH: DEFENSE AND PASSING
images.prompt: A legible tactical training replay screen in the same 3D Harbor Park arena, elevated camera showing whole field, 4 robots exactly (2 cyan,2 orange) and only ONE ball. Near cyan goal, cyan11 makes a defensive interception while cyan07 moves into open sideline space. One short dotted cyan pass lane toward07. Orange striker has a thin orange projected shooting lane blocked by11. A small bottom replay scrub bar with PAUSED and PLAY, two short callouts 'COVER GOAL' near defender and 'PASS INTO SPACE' near open teammate. Top 'TEAMWORK LAB'. Clear separation between illustrative projected paths and actual ball, restrained visual trails. No extra ghost players. This is coach replay/training visualization, not mandatory live match overlays.

images.title: CLUB CUSTOMIZATION

Main center preview shows cyan07 white round robot beside matching cyan11 teammate with a simple striped jersey and glowing cyan tether spool. Left four neat category tabs 'COLORS' 'JERSEY' 'FACE' 'TRAIL'. Right palette of 8 tasteful color swatches and three simple jersey pattern thumbnails; selected cyan orange team accent combo. shared_style_prompt: ONE original landscape concept image for TETHER LEAGUE. Use the provided original screenshot as a style reference: rounded white robots, black expressive face screens, cyan/orange jerseys, cyan tether beams, yellow anchors, bright lightweight stylized 3D stadiums, navy/ivory sports interface, rounded panels, bold readable sport typography, warm sunlight, restrained effects and minimal clutter. Create the requested new screen rather than duplicating the reference. No device mockups, watermarks, or real-game logos. Exact per-image scene brief follows in each prompt.
